ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) central region with high-intensity (white) distal patches; estimated 75:25 dark-to-light pixel ratio across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-pigmented central mass extending to the fluke base; distinct high-contrast white patches localized on the distal upper-left and upper-right lobes with significant stippled mottling at the pigment transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped central notch; approximately 15-20 degree interior angle with a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; prominent sharp peaks and jagged valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes, particularly dense on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a steep convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular/conical pixel groupings (barnacles) localized on the extreme lateral edges of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks or scratches) within the white pigmented zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the outer margins; numerous small nicks and irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge serration profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical boundary of white-to-black pigmentation on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.
